correctness.rationale: For b>=3, k>=2 the carry recurrence leaves [-M,0] invariant, and the prefix digits of any complete-residue expansion are unique modulo the corresponding radix power. Thus resetting every carry to zero is equivalent to representing every integer of [A-M,A]. For k>=3 the residue prescribed by the two exceptional digits at positions k-2 and k-3 has a least possible nonnegative representative Q=(b^k-1)(b^(k-2)+b^(k-3))>b^(2k-2); an interval of M+1 integers cannot avoid that residue modulo b^(k-1). For k=2, the represented integers below b^2 are the two-digit ordinary restricted grid plus the isolated b^2-1, whose runs are too short. At length 2k-1 use the unique signed-digit block n=BV+e, -M<=e<=(b-2)M. In regular blocks the top digit -1 is impossible. Over the rest of a block the lower mask has digits 0 or 1, and membership requires V minus that mask to have digits 0 through b-2. An interior V accepts all masks; any digit b-1 excludes the zero mask and any zero digit excludes the mask concentrated on that digit. The lower signed digits repeat every b^(k-1) values, bounding runs in noninterior blocks. One endpoint detail implicit in the decomposition: at the start of the truncated final block V=b^(k-1), e=-M has all signed digits -1, so the mask E=M exceeds V and this integer is absent. That single gap prevents joining the preceding block, and this truncated block has at most M integers. Each interior run has (b-1)b^(k-1) integers, hence exactly (b-1)b^(k-1)-M admissible right endpoints. This proves the full interval and count, including b=3. An independent direct carry replay enumerated all words at lengths 2k-2 and 2k-1 for (3,2), (3,3), (4,2), (4,3), (5,2), (5,3), (6,2); no shorter candidate at the tested length reset, and the exact lists matched (counts 2, 5, 14, 108, 42, 621, 92). Zero-padding preserves zero reset. The supplied verify.py and its 32-check output were inspected, not run; finite checks do not establish the unlimited result.

value.rationale: The family changes a single residue representative in the ordinary radix alphabet and is a natural test of shortest-length questions left open by the qualitative theory. The complete minimizing input census is a useful exact invariant, not merely the already known ternary length or a larger finite table: it shows how local borrow obstructions govern all shortest words and gives every admissible prefix value in every base in scope.
